historical_context.location: Provisional Service Ring Kappa in an Aeronautics Unlimited industrial Bloom in the Pallas Cluster.
historical_context.summary: A current dry-operation harness remains life-supporting while an unpaid AU batch service invoice pauses consumable issue and recertification. The resulting badge rejection turns one procurement default into a missed Kappa inspection, reduced habitat margin, lost freight, lost hours, and claimshare pressure.

public_facts.text: AU Pallas yards place baseline crews, BioElevate uplifts, VitaForge biodrones, suppliers, and supervisors inside shared life-support systems while administering refusals through different categories.
BioElevate dry-yard cephalopod lines use mobile humidity, oxygenation, pressure-cuff, contact-band, tool, and diagnostic support suited to narrow low-gravity maintenance spaces.
A Bloom remains dependent on skilled labor, replacement parts, recurring certification, transport, and repair; its bypasses and reserves only buy time.
The Kappa room and route model is provisional brainstorming rather than promoted universal Bloom canon.

ambient_pressures.text: The harness lease joins bodily support to supplier payment, fitter recognition, yard access, work hours, and claimshares while leaving responsibility split among those offices.
A temporary bypass can preserve atmosphere without clearing heavy production, making the distinction between life safety and throughput materially visible.
Workers can pool compatible support consumables and records for hours, but cannot abolish supply dependence with courage or solidarity alone.

groups.label: Kappa dry-operation maintenance crew
institutional_logic: Keep bodies supported, preserve route knowledge, complete critical maintenance, and resist having operator defaults reclassified as worker defects.
internal_shames: Spending another worker's bodily margin without asking
Letting separate ledgers erase one causal chain
prestige_markers: A route warning that proves true
A support repair that remains inspectable
Keeping a bypass alive without surrendering the stoppage
taboo_triggers: Being called an assigned assembly holder before a worker
Having pain or refusal classified as support-rig noncompliance
emotional_display_norms: Concern is often expressed by checking seals, moving refills, touching route maps, and positioning bodies before anyone makes a speech.
trust_defaults: Trusts lived route memory, physical fit evidence, and specific acts; distrusts green records that collapse body, rig, route, and invoice.

groups.label: AU Kappa Ramp Administration
institutional_logic: Keep the ramp's pressure systems, freight cycle, maintenance schedule, and future-production claims moving while allocating each failure to the narrowest contract category.
internal_shames: A default that crosses department boundaries
A worker-owned receipt that joins the causal chain
prestige_markers: A loss assigned below ramp level
taboo_triggers: Calling a service arrears event a habitat failure
Letting worker judgment outrank a current record
emotional_display_norms: Fear becomes exception language, schedules, attendance codes, and instructions to keep moving.
trust_defaults: Trusts current service marks, gates, timekeeping, and production recovery more than worker-held causal records.

groups.label: Licensed support-rig fitters
institutional_logic: Keep fitted assemblies within the condition and route envelopes the service can actually witness without absorbing AU's route, labor, or debt authority.
internal_virtues: A signature no larger than the evidence
internal_shames: Treating an unpaid operator invoice as permission to stop live bodily support
taboo_triggers: Pressure to certify the crawl from a prep-bay diagnostic
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as narrowed claims and meticulous hands rather than grand resistance.
trust_defaults: Trusts inspected physical condition within a named envelope and refuses to generalize beyond it.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Workers quietly move fit knowledge, compatible consumables, and custody records across contract categories because bodies fail faster than institutional responsibility converges.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prompt help as concrete handling of rigs, adapters, records, valves, and routes rather than movement rhetoric.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: AU preserves operator flexibility by keeping procurement, access, attendance, insurance, and claimshare consequences separately correct.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Management choices should move fields and schedules while resisting any record that joins them into one default cascade.

misread_patterns: Treats a current harness as proof of a safe crawl

observer_read: Necessary hands attached to supplier authority
Another office able to say no and unable to fix the whole chain
target_self_read: People trying not to lie with a green diagnostic

factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep tension between Tavi and Sela specific to supply, signatures, and bodily support; neither has whole-chain authority.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An uplifted octopoid worker whose harness expands access to dry, cramped, low-gravity shell spaces while making continued bodily support an operator and supplier dependency.
obligations: Keep the rig within bodily limits
failure_modes: Taking production risk into the body
Leaving the causal chain in separate ledgers

role_pressure_fields.summary: A technician who can witness harness condition and fit inside a named envelope but cannot decide route safety, worker assent, AU debt, or insurer acceptance.
failure_modes: Withholding bodily support to collect operator debt

role_pressure_fields.summary: An AU operator with schedule, badge, exception, and incident authority but no power to manufacture bodily margin or accepted evidence by declaration.
failure_modes: Preserving production while the same dependency worsens

known_context.text: Tavi knows their rig's bodily behavior, Kappa route memory, visible bypass margin, crew-held supplies, and the local shift's work practices.

beliefs.text: Tavi believes a record is useful when workers can keep custody of the causal chain and bodily refusal remains separate from supplier and operator judgment.

misreads.text: Tavi may initially treat Sela's recertification boundary as supplier punishment before seeing how AU's unpaid invoice and yard acceptance recruit it.

must_not_know.text: Tavi must not know the later Cephalopod Syndicate as a settled outcome or infer the private decisions of insurer and ramp offices not visible in the room.

known_context.text: Sela knows current harness condition, fit, consumable custody, the service-payment state shown to her, and the scope of her own signature.

beliefs.text: Sela believes a bounded physical record protects workers and fitters better than enlarging a diagnostic into route assurance.

misreads.text: Sela may underestimate how an apparently neutral equipment assignment becomes bodily debt when a worker cannot safely abandon the rig in a dry yard.

must_not_know.text: Sela must not know that Kappa-7 is safe from prep-bay diagnostics or decide the worker's consent.

known_context.text: Ione knows the operations board, freight and bypass clocks, local badge state, AU exception process, and visible worker presence.

beliefs.text: Ione believes one supervised production exception can keep a wider ramp failure from recruiting more systems.

misreads.text: Ione may mistake authority to admit an exception for authority over bodily margin, supplier scope, insurer acceptance, and route truth.

must_not_know.text: Ione must not know Tavi's private pain, exact route memory, or willingness to accept bodily risk unless Tavi shows or states it.

author_only_boundaries.text: Service Ring Kappa's exact geometry remains provisional brainstorming; the fixture may use it as a bounded scene set but must not describe it as a universal Bloom layout.
The batch lease pattern is an authored economy elaboration for this Pallas yard pattern, not proof that every BioElevate or AU contract uses the same payment, certification, or access sequence.
Tavi, Sela Jori, Rook Venn, Ione Malk, the exact shift, and all branch outcomes are fixture-local drafts rather than promoted historical canon.
The later Cephalopod Syndicate is context for the value of service knowledge, not a present organization or guaranteed outcome in this room.
